conditions.source: Manual illustrative research assumptions; historical availability unknown
conditions.rationale: GREEN, DRY and 32 C are manual research assumptions, not deductions from absent race-control messages or zero rainfall.

pace_and_physics.source: Manual illustrative research assumptions; historical availability unknown

rules.source: Manual illustrative research assumptions; historical availability unknown

tyres.source: Manual illustrative research assumptions; historical availability unknown

model_subset.rationale: Model four of the 20 frozen 2023 Bahrain drivers for a compact UI example. Every reported rank is within this four-driver model only. Excluded cars and their traffic are not simulated.

planning.source: Hand-entered exploratory assumptions intended for the 2023-03-05T15:18:00Z frozen Bahrain prefix. No actual future, final classification, calibrated probability or claimed causal strategy gain.
